messages.author: 91dd08d59b2a146b
messages.subject: grf simulation with INLA
parts:
Dear colleagues,

given a particular spatial covariance function, can we use INLA to generate a realization of a grf with zero mean and that particular covariance model?

Thanks,
Pablo Juan

messages.author: bbb9357156c132fe
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] grf simulation with INLA
parts:
If you have a sparse precision matrix, inla.qsample will do it  

For general covariance functions, maybe the RandomFields package would be more appropriate  

D

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] grf simulation with INLA
parts:
On 17 Dec 2013, at 08:52, Pablo Gregori Huerta <gre...@uji.es> wrote:
But what if the covariance function does not belong to the Matérn family?

The spde models implemented in inla include a few that are not Matern, but they are more naturally approached from the point of view of building spde models, and not from prespecified covariances.

Like Daniel said, the RandomFields package may be more useful for other standard models.

Finn
